title: Chapter 464: Crisis Of The Frost Empire
content:
Chapter 464: Crisis Of The Frost Empire

As for the matter of the novice trial area, Wang Shuo handed it over to Duan Wenxi, selected some newcomers with potential, and put them into the novice area, just as a move of chess.

Unlike Wang Zhu and Liu Hong, Wang Shuo already had absolute confidence in the novice area.

But Wang Shuo changed his mind at this time, they should have had absolute confidence at the beginning!

Thinking of this, Wang Shuo still occasionally paid attention to the matter of the novice area.

The days slipped away slowly.

A month later, Zhao Bangde returned safely and broke through to the strongest king.

At the same time, he also got a resurrection pill from Lord Zak.

After a brief exchange with Wang Shuo, he couldn't wait to take the resurrection pill and went to the Warcraft Mountains.

After some thought, Wang Shuo decided to let Ayub enter the Tomb of the King.

Just as the Vana Empire continued to accumulate top combat power, the various empires on the Valandia continent were engaged in epic wars.

Countless empires, conquering each other, and wars continued.

On this day, Master Tongchui's disciple suddenly came to ask for help.

"You mean, the Frost Empire will encounter a catastrophe this time?"

Master Tongchui's disciple told Wang Shuo the situation of the Frost Empire in detail.

After discussing with everyone, Wang Shuo decided to go there in person.

On the one hand, it was because of Master Tongchui's favor, and on the other hand, Wang Shuo remembered the kiss in the water.

"How can we go to the Frost Empire?" Wang Shuo was a little worried. If we go too late, the opportunity will be gone.

"Your Majesty Shura, I have chosen a path. We just need to rush to the nearest teleportation array and then teleport all the way there."

In the Vlandia continent, many teleportation arrays between empires are not open, but there are always some neutral cities that can be used for long-distance teleportation.

At this time, it is necessary to find a teleportation path.

You know, for ultra-long-distance teleportation, the number of energy crystals required is very large, and the teleporter needs to prepare it himself, and he also has to pay tolls.

But these are nothing for an empire.

So Wang Shuo set off immediately. After three days of teleportation, Wang Shuo finally arrived at the Sky City, the capital of the Frost Empire.

Sky City is not built in the sky.

It is still on the ground.

When he came to the city, he was surrounded by hostile forces outside the city.

Wang Shuo was immediately welcomed into the palace by a prince of the royal Ye family.

Master Tongchui and the emperor of the Frost Empire hosted a banquet for Wang Shuo.

At this time, the hostile forces outside the city had not yet started to attack the city.

Although the atmosphere in the city was a little tense, it was not out of control.

Master Tongchui stood up and saluted: "Your Majesty Chi Tong Shura is indeed a trustworthy person. I am deeply relieved that you can come to me in times of crisis."

The Emperor Ye Hui of the Frost Empire also stood up to greet him: "Your Majesty Chi Tong Shura, you have worked hard all the way. Please take a seat."

After Wang Shuo sat down, he returned the greeting and said with a smile: "You two don't have to be polite. You should just call me by my name. This Majesty Chi Tong Shura is really a bit weird."

"Ah, haha! Okay, then we will call each other by our names. My name is Ye Hui."

Wang Shuo looked around and found that there were only three of them, so he said straight to the point.

"I don't know what the situation is now."

Ye Hui sighed, shook his head and said: "The attackers this time are the Parthian Empire, together with the Truni Empire and several other small countries. There are nearly 10 strongest kings."

Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows and felt a little tricky.
